annotations.title: Base token deep safety check (rug-pull / honeypot)

description: Deep Base token safety / rug-pull / honeypot check: everything in token_safety_check plus DEX liquidity (Uniswap, Aerodrome), holder shares, mint/blacklist/fee functions, a simulated buy, and a 0-100 risk score with a low/medium/high verdict. Price: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402, charged only on success.

address.description: Contract address of the ERC-20 token to check, on Base mainnet (chain id 8453): 0x followed by 40 hex characters, e.g. 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (USDC). Checksummed or lowercase both work. Not a wallet address or a token symbol.
